cycle: Standard Time per Piece — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
shift: Machine Shift Time = Machine OFF Time − Machine ON Time
idealQty: Ideal Quantity = Machine Shift Time × 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece, as the sheet shows it (not rounded). TOTAL QTY can't be more than it rounded down — a part-piece can't be made.
rejectedQty: Rejected QTY = TOTAL QTY − OK QTY.
pctOk: Ok Quantity (%) = OK QTY ÷ TOTAL QTY
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total Idle Time = every downtime column added up — Ask Query To QC Team, Empty Bag Tugging and Stock Counting included.
effective: Effective Machine Run Time = TOTAL QTY × Standard Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece run counts on this sheet.
unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Effective Machine Run Time × 60 − Total Idle Time, for this entry (a day on Process Master's locked shift: combined across the operator's date).
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Total Idle Time ÷ 60), for this entry (a day on Process Master's locked shift: combined across the operator's date).
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch ÷ 60), for this entry (a locked-shift day: combined).
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and COT = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), for this entry (a locked-shift day: combined).
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Machine Shift − every downtime column; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch − Planned Down Time (the planned stops). Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Standard Time per Piece × TOTAL QTY ÷ Operating Time, for this entry. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong time per piece, quantity or downtime.
quality: Quality = OK QTY ÷ TOTAL QTY, for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance or Quality is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
idealQtyPerHour: Ideal Quantity/Hours = 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece
